_comment: VocaTrain_ios: the SwiftUI app and VocaTrainKit. No deploy: a request ends as built, and scripts/testflight.sh uploads by hand.

The app build runs unsandboxed (build_unsandboxed): xcodebuild resolves the local VocaTrainKit package through the user's SwiftPM cache, which the sandbox must not open. Xcode project files are build files, so a change to them needs review first.

The tests are VocaTrainKit's (swift test, no simulator) in the sandbox. Swift Build writes to the per-user temp folder whatever TMPDIR says (sandbox_user_temp), and SwiftPM's own caches are pointed into the run's temp dir. The simulator UI tests (scripts/test.sh) need the dev API and the test account, so they don't run here.
deploy_order 10: in a request with vt-backend, the server deploys before the app that calls it.
build_cmd: xcodebuild build -quiet -project VocaTrain_ios/VocaTrain.xcodeproj -scheme VocaTrain -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
